blocks.tamil_translation: sin of breaking off friendship. If the one who came forward to make friends says Salam, and the other does not accept his Salam (does not answer), the angels answer the one who said Salam, and Shaytan answers the other. If both die in the state of broken friendship, they will neither go to Jannah nor be united in Jannah.” Hazrat Hisham ibn Amir (RA) narrates that he heard Rasulullah ﷺ say this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ فَضَالَةَ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ ﵁ اَنَّ رَسُوْلَ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ: مَنْ هَجَرَ اَخَاهُ فَوْقَ ثَلَاثٍ فَهُوَ فِي النَّارِ، اِلَّا اَنْ يَتَدَارَكَهُ اللهُ بِرَحْمَتِهِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الطبراني ورجاله رجال الصحيح، مجمع الزوائد: ٨ /١٣١
blocks.tamil_translation: then he will go to Jahannam. But if Allah Ta'ala helps him by His mercy (he will escape Jahannam). Hazrat Fadalah ibn Ubaid (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَبِيْ خِرَاشِ نِ السُّلَمِيِّ ﵁ اَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَسُوْلَ اللهِ ﷺ يَقُوْلُ: مَنْ هَجَرَ اَخَاهُ سَنَةً، فَهُوَ كَسَفْكِ دَمِهِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابو داؤد، باب في هجرة الرجل اخاه، رقم:٤٩١٥
blocks.tamil_translation: “Whoever keeps off friendship with his Muslim brother (out of anger) for a period of one year, it is like shedding his blood!” (The sin of breaking off friendship for a whole year and the sin of killing unjustly are equal to each other.)” Hazrat Abu Khirash Sulami (RA) narrates that he heard Rasulullah ﷺ say this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ جَابِرٍ ﵁ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ يَقُوْلُ: اِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ قَدْ اَيِسَ اَنْ يَعْبُدَهُ الْمُصَلُّوْنَ فِيْ جَزِيْرَةِ الْعَرَبِ، وَلكِنْ فِي التَّحْرِيْشِ
